        ### Options

opb. If we decide to perform a cardioversion upon arrival in the Emergency Department, it would be necessary to previously perform a transesophageal echocardiography.

opd. To slow the heart rate we could use beta-blockers.

CHAIN: First episode of atrial fibrillation can be treated with catheter ablation -> Catheter ablation is typically considered for recurrent atrial fibrillation -> This patient has only one episode -> He is not the ideal candidate for catheter ablation -> 80%
